apple-craft-and-interaction-physics.description: Enforces Apple Human Interface Guidelines (HIG) craft, Design Engineering, and 60/120Hz Interaction Physics across web, mobile, and desktop interfaces. Mandates Exhaustive UI State Matrices (loading skeleton, empty, partial error, offline, optimistic rollback), Zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS = 0.000 via strict geometry pre-reservation), Interruptible Spring Physics with velocity continuity, Keyboard and Focus Ring Mastery, and 120Hz compositor budgeting. Use when designing, building, refactoring, or auditing interactive UI components, animations, transitions, state machines, gesture handlers, modals, forms, or rendering pipelines — even if the user does not explicitly say "Apple HIG" or "interaction physics". Do NOT use for headless backend-only services, database DDL migrations, or non-interactive CLI batch scripts.

axioms.title: `loading_skeleton`:
axioms.assertion: Render a pixel-matched skeleton whose outer dimensions, padding, and layout tracks match the resolved state to the exact pixel (`CLS = 0`).

axioms.title: `empty`:
axioms.assertion: A first-class zero-state with clear contextual guidance and a prominent, actionable CTA (never a blank void or generic "No items").

axioms.title: `partial_error`:
axioms.assertion: Isolate sub-region component failures with an inline retry affordance; secondary component failures must NEVER crash or blank the primary screen.

axioms.title: `offline`:
axioms.assertion: Surface a non-intrusive offline indicator, preserve cached content for reading, and queue non-destructive mutations locally.

axioms.title: `optimistic_rollback`:
axioms.assertion: Instantaneous visual feedback (< 16ms) and optimistic state transition (< 50ms) backed by an immutable rollback snapshot (`previousStateSnapshot`); if the server rejects, gracefully revert and restore the user's exact draft text into the active input.

axioms.title: `loaded_fresh`:
axioms.assertion: Canonical populated interactive state.

axioms.title: `revalidating_stale`:
axioms.assertion: Keep existing data fully interactive on screen while displaying a subtle, non-blocking refresh indicator (never flash full-screen loaders during background sync).

axioms.title: `terminal_error`:
axioms.assertion: Full-screen or modal failure with actionable recovery options, retry button, and clear incident correlation tokens.

axioms.title: Compile-Time Exhaustiveness:
axioms.assertion: Banish combinatorial booleans (`isLoading`, `isError`). Model states as a Discriminated Union with a tag (`status`). Enforce `assertNever(state)` in the default branch of every state switch.

axioms.title: Instant Interruption:
axioms.assertion: Every animation and transition must be immediately interruptible at any point in its timeline by user input (pointer down, swipe, click, key press). Never lock interaction behind animation duration queues.

axioms.title: Velocity Inheritance:
axioms.assertion: When a motion is interrupted mid-flight, the new trajectory must inherit the instantaneous velocity ($v_0$) of the interrupted motion ($F = -kx - cv$). Snapping to 0 velocity or jumping to target geometry is a physical defect.

axioms.title: Banning `transition: all`:
axioms.assertion: Explicitly declare animated compositor properties (`transition: transform ...`). Never use `transition: all`, which captures layout properties during responsive resizes.

axioms.title: Compositor-Only Properties:
axioms.assertion: Animate strictly GPU-composited properties: `transform` (`translate3d`, `scale`, `rotate`) and `opacity`. Animating `height`, `width`, `top`, `left`, `margin`, `padding`, or `border-width` triggers document reflow and is strictly prohibited.

axioms.title: Epsilon Convergence:
axioms.assertion: Spring calculations and `requestAnimationFrame` loops must check convergence ($\epsilon \le 10^{-4}$) and immediately call `cancelAnimationFrame(handle)` when $|\text{current} - \text{target}| < \epsilon$ and $|\text{velocity}| < \epsilon$.

axioms.title: Respect Motion Preferences:
axioms.assertion: Honor `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` by immediately completing animations or degrading to instant opacity cross-fades.

axioms.title: Focus Ring Discipline:
axioms.assertion: Never suppress focus outlines (`outline: none`, `outline: 0`) without providing an explicit, high-contrast replacement. Enforce `:focus-visible` styling with a minimum 3:1 contrast ratio against the background, at least a 2px stroke, and `outline-offset: 2px` so the ring is never clipped.

axioms.title: Modal & Drawer Focus Trapping & Restoration:
axioms.assertion: Every slide-out drawer, bottom sheet, and modal dialog must declare `role="dialog"` and `aria-modal="true"`, trap `Tab` and `Shift+Tab` cycles inside the container, and programmatically restore focus to the trigger element that opened it upon dismissal (`Escape` or close button).

axioms.title: Roving Tabindex for Composite Controls:
axioms.assertion: Composite widgets (toolbars, segmented controls, tablists, menus, data grids) must implement the Roving Tabindex pattern (`tabIndex={isActive ? 0 : -1}`) with Arrow-key navigation to eliminate tab-stop exhaustion.

axioms.title: Screen Reader Semantics & ARIA Live Regions:
axioms.assertion: Surface dynamic state changes and toast notifications via `aria-live="polite"` or `role="status"`. Declare `aria-busy="true"` on containers undergoing async updates. Provide explicit accessible names (`aria-label` or visually hidden text) for all icon buttons.

axioms.title: Zero Layout Thrashing:
axioms.assertion: Never interleave DOM style mutations and layout reads (`getBoundingClientRect()`, `offsetWidth`, `offsetHeight`, `scrollTop`). Batch all layout reads first, then execute style mutations in `requestAnimationFrame`.

axioms.title: Zero Main-Thread Blocking:
axioms.assertion: Never execute synchronous `JSON.parse`/`JSON.stringify`, `localStorage` I/O, or heavy sorting over large arrays inside input, render, or scroll handlers. Offload to Web Workers or slice with `scheduler.yield()`.

axioms.title: Touch Device Native Inertia:
axioms.assertion: Never apply programmatic scroll hijacking or custom wheel smoothing to touch devices. Gate momentum scroll engines behind `!window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches && window.innerWidth >= 768`.
